text:
liz_sales: Hey team — onboarding convo with Orion Financial this morning. They're ready to start a 4-week POC but have several legal/security asks (DPA edits, SOC2 artifacts) and need an ops timeline + cost for a Dedicated trial. Can we align?

eric_ps: Quick Q — what are their success criteria? relevance thresholds, latency SLOs, and what eval data can they share?

liz_sales: They gave a short doc: target is ML relevance > 85% on their prompt set, p95 latency < 500ms, no sensitive data logged. Also want cost estimate for 1 month of reserved capacity (ish 50 qps peak).

marta_security: From security side we'll need: latest SOC2 Type II report (PDF), signed DPA (they sent edits), data flow diagram, encryption at rest details (KMS/HSM), and pen-test scope/acceptance criteria. Also confirm whether PHI could appear in prompts (HIPAA).

legal_anna: @liz_sales please share the customer's DPA redlines. If PHI is in scope we need to evaluate BA/BAA language. We can accept standard redlines but need to confirm logging policy and retention.

sam_se: For the POC I'd recommend Private (VPC) deployment to reduce data leakage concerns. We can do Hosted with strong redaction, but their compliance team prefers VPC. For pricing: I'll pull numbers for a 1-month Dedicated trial with burst capacity.

devops_ben: Blockers from infra side: 1) network peering details from Orion 2) staging credentials + sample dataset (anonymized) 3) CIDR allowlist for our staging endpoints 4) support window / on-call for test days. If those are ready we can stand up env in ~5 business days.

eric_ps: For evals: ask them for a representative set (~500 prompts) and a small blind holdout (~100). We'll run our prompt archetypes (classification, contextual QA, rerank). Metrics: top-1 accuracy/relevance, hallucination rate, latency distribution, token usage cost.

sam_se: Example prompt archetypes (copy/paste):
```
1) Financial summary extraction: "Extract account balances and flags from the note:"
2) Compliance Q&A: "Is this message reportable under X rule?"
3) Customer support framing: short answer with citations
```

marta_security: Re: pen-test — customer asked for a 3rd-party pen-test report. Options: they can provide their own assessment, we can provide our most recent pen-test, or we can coordinate a scoped pen-test during the POC. Note: full external pentest will add ~2-3 weeks and require a test plan.

liz_sales: They prefer us to provide SOC2 + recent pen-test first. If that clears, they'll skip a mandatory external test for POC. Can we expedite?

marta_security: We can share SOC2 Type II + summary of last pentest next day. Full pentest scheduling requires approval and scope doc; can't be immediate. Also: need to confirm GDPR lawful basis and retention for EU user data if any test data originates from EU.

legal_anna: Also request: logging policy that shows redaction rules, data retention timeline (default 30 days or customer configured), and deletion process. We'll add those to DPA comments.

eric_ps: Proposed success criteria (to confirm with Orion):
- Relevance >= 85% on their eval set
- p95 latency < 500ms for 95% of samples during test windows
- No PII/PHI persisted in staging logs (proof via log sample)
- Cost estimate <= $X per 1k tokens (sales to fill final number)
- Integration: SDK calls + example infra runbook executed by their SRE

sam_se: I'll draft an ops timeline:
Week 0: legal signoff + DPA executed, SOC2 & pen-test artifacts shared
Week 1: infra access, VPC peering, sample data ingested, first smoke tests
Week 2: run full eval (~600 prompts), iterate prompts/temperature, canary to small internal users
Week 3: performance tuning, batching/quantization suggestions, cost optimization
Week 4: final run, collect metrics, slide pack + go/no-go

devops_ben: Ops checklist (for kickoff):
- [ ] DPA signed
- [ ] Network peering completed
- [ ] Staging credentials + anonymized dataset uploaded
- [ ] KMS key access (if using customer-managed keys)
- [ ] Contact window for 2x on-call engineers during run days

liz_sales: I'll assign owners: @eric_ps to own evals, @devops_ben to own infra, @marta_security + @legal_anna for artifacts. I'll also confirm pricing numbers by EOD.

marta_security: One more GDPR/HIPAA note: if they will supply real customer data, we need a data processing addendum with deletion timelines and DSAR procedures. If they can't anonymize, we move to Private on-prem or bring-your-own-key option.

eric_ps: For the eval run, please provide a CSV with columns: prompt, expected_output, tolerance_notes. We will run deterministic seeds and upload result CSV with diff metrics.

liz_sales: I'll schedule kickoff for Tue 10am PT and share a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-orion-poc (docs + DPA redlines will be there).

se-bot: POC ticket created: #POC-12345 — owners assigned: eric_ps, devops_ben.

liz_sales: Anything else blocking? If not, I'll push invites and ask Orion for network peering details + anonymized eval set before Monday. :thumbsup:

marta_security: Please redact any direct account numbers in sample data. If redaction isn't possible, mark as sensitive and we'll treat as PHI.

eric_ps: Sounds good. I'll draft the eval plan and prompt templates and post in the Drive by EOD tomorrow.

liz_sales: Great, thanks everyone — will follow up with calendar invite + check back on DPA status.
